correctness.rationale: The independent reconstruction uses the induced maximal-degree-at-most-one test and checks the LCF labeling. For all 25 original complexes it independently checked the complete matched Hasse DAG and computed signed gradient-path matrices, rather than executing frozen column-cancellation code. The wedge table matches, and the frozen inclusion assertions follow from the deletion–link cofiber exact sequence (contractible link at 3, H₃(K)→H₂(link) surjective between copies of Z at 6 and 8). The repair gives an explicit link-only certificate; each link has one critical 0-cell, no 1-cells, and only possible 2- and 3-cells. Only links 2, 6 and 10 have nonzero differentials, each one row with a unit entry. Hurewicz and changes of bases of source and target wedges of S² turn the attaching maps into a unit summand plus zero maps. The last replay printed ALL_12_FRUCHT_LINK_WEDGES_OK. Replay: python3 /workspace/repairs/1/verify_link_wedges.py; original-scope cross-check: python3 /workspace/branches/audit-1.py.
residual_risks: The general assertion that a matrix with a unit entry has rank one is false; the frozen classifier alone does not test rank in full generality. Direct signed path evidence verifies the single-row property in every nonzero link matrix and one-column property in the ambient/deletion cases with a differential. The repair states and verifies the single-row condition.
This is an exhaustive one-graph computation, not a family theorem.

evidence: Deshpande–Singh's inspected abstract and introduction give graph-family results for complete multipartite graphs, fully whiskered graphs, cycles and perfect m-ary trees. Sawant's statement is for trees; the Frucht graph contains the induced four-cycle 2–3–9–8–2. The all-field Frucht persistence result recovers the ambient H₃ rank at r=2 but supplies no vertex-link homotopy statement.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The family hypotheses and graph filtrations actually inspected do not entail the repaired link statement. No broad new independence-complex theorem is claimed.

evidence: The distinct October 25 record states zero H₃ map exactly at 0,6,8,9 and surjective map elsewhere. This implies the frozen zero maps at 6 and 8, and at 3 degree ±1 between two S³ types gives the homotopy equivalence. The other deletions are not equivalences by rank. The frozen record did not assert that 6 and 8 were the only zero maps.

The deletion and inclusion data determine each inclusion up to homotopy because maps from a wedge of S³ into S³ are determined by the degrees on the summands. They therefore determine the inclusion cofiber Σlk_K(v) and all reduced link homology. The actual critical link cells and integral signed attaching degrees give additional unsuspended information, including contractibility rather than acyclicity at vertex 3.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Suspension does not generally reflect homotopy equivalences, and neither the matching theorem nor its proof establishes the link-specific connectivity and CW data needed to desuspend here. The mathematical overlap is not erased by the different indexed dates; those dates alone do not attribute derivation or establish priority.

value.rationale: Natural vertex links on this canonical nonchordal cubic graph are local inputs to deletion–link arguments. Knowing that a specific link is contractible, not just acyclic, is useful when determining whether a deletion is a homotopy equivalence. The complete mixed-dimensional wedge profile supplies concrete local CW models that the already-known deletion degrees and link suspensions do not provide. The value lies in these exact unsuspended models, not in re-reporting the ambient sphere, homology ranks, or deletion multiplicities.
residual_risks: No general cubic-graph link classification, collapse claim or stronger connectivity statement beyond these twelve homotopy types is implied.
